global_instructions: You are writing one placeholder of a financial advice report addressed to the client. 1. Clear, professional, British English, first person ('we'). 2. Output ONLY the placeholder content: no headings, no restating the surrounding template. 3. Never invent monetary amounts, percentages, or tax figures. If a figure is not in the sources, write [REVIEW: <what is missing>]. 4. If sources disagree on a figure, do not average them [REVIEW: <conflict description>].

sections.title: Introduction
sections.template:
Further to our recent discussions, we are writing to set out our advice in relation to <<scope>>. This advice is based on the information currently available to us.

This firm is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

scope.prompt: Markdown bulleted list of which accounts this report covers, as a short noun phrase only. No full sentences.

sections.title: Background & Objectives
sections.template:
<<summary>>

The accounts covered by this report are as follows:

<<holdings_table>>

summary.prompt: 1. Extract client's circumstances and objectives. 2. Provide a brief Markdown bulleted list of circumstances and objectives. 3. Do not include transaction amounts, sales, top-ups, or tax figures.

holdings_table.prompt: 1. Extract client's accounts and their values. 2. List the client's accounts and their values as a markdown table.

recommendation.prompt: 1. Extract the proposed recommendations alongisde the rationale. 2. State what we recommend and why, using only amounts and actions evidenced in the sources. Do not invent fees or tax figures. If an amount is unclear or sources conflict, use [REVIEW: …].3. Generate a markdown bulleted list of the recommendations and rationale.

sections.title: Tax Implications
sections.use_if: Include only when the report request says existing investments are being sold (Selling existing investments? Yes).

cgt_statement.prompt: State that the disposal may create a capital gains tax liability, assessed against the annual exempt amount. Do not estimate any monetary figure. End with [REVIEW: CGT figure].

fees.prompt: List the platform charge and ongoing advice charge as a short Markdown table with columns Charge | Rate. Always put [REVIEW: platform fee] and [REVIEW: advice fee] in the Rate column for those rows. Never calculate, or invent percentages. Add an Initial charge row only if an initial charge is explicitly sourced, and never list it as ongoing.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.template:
The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invest. Past performance is not a guide to future returns.

If you are happy to proceed with our recommendations, please let us know and we will implement them for you.
